meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research for design direction. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建和优化前端界面，提升视觉品质与用户体验
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速搭建或改进网页界面，注重视觉细节和性能
copy.tagline_en: Build and polish frontend interfaces for better visual quality and UX
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly build or improve web interfaces with attention to visual detail and performance

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照专业前端工作流处理 UI/UX 任务：先加载设计规则，再根据请求类型（如新建、改版、性能审计）执行对应流程，最终产出符合设计系统且性能达标（Lighthouse 100）的代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“前端”、“UI”、“UX”、“设计”、“改版”、“样式”、“布局”、“动画”、“React”、“Lighthouse”、“可访问性”等关键词，或要求“让它好看”、“像某品牌风格”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个类似 Stripe 的着陆页，先出 DESIGN.md。
say.note: 触发设计系统创建流程，加载品牌参考并生成设计文档。

say.text: 把这个按钮样式改成毛玻璃效果，更新 DESIGN.md。
say.note: 触发样式修改流程，更新设计系统文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a professional frontend workflow for UI/UX tasks: first loads design rules, then executes the appropriate process based on request type (new, redesign, performance audit), and finally produces code that meets design system standards and achieves Lighthouse 100.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "frontend", "UI", "UX", "design", "redesign", "styling", "layout", "animation", "React", "Lighthouse", "accessibility", or ask to "make it pretty" or "like X brand".

say_en.text: Design a landing page like Stripe, start with DESIGN.md.
say_en.note: Triggers design system creation, loads brand reference, generates design doc.

say_en.text: Audit this React page performance with Playwright Lighthouse.
say_en.note: Triggers performance audit, runs real browser tests.

say_en.text: Change this button style to glassmorphism, update DESIGN.md.
say_en.note: Triggers style modification, updates design system doc.
